# Audit Requirements Quality Checklist: Fractal Explorer — Phase 00 boundary audit

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the Phase 00 requirements (completeness, privacy, architecture ownership, iOS lifecycle,
testability, performance and release constraints)
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Focus: the manual's three Phase 00 gates, its required capability audit (§6), the A03 rules that the escape-time
formulas are app-domain with a CPU reference and that precision is a stated, clamped limit, and the reuse rule. Depth: phase gate. Audience: reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all three manual acceptance gates required: integration matrix, compilable shell and written stop/go decision? [Completeness, Spec §FR-A03-002, §FR-A03-005, §FR-A03-009]
- [x] CHK002 Does the inventory requirement name the areas a fractal explorer depends on (full-screen fragment passes and uniforms, shader precision, palettes, pinch/pan input, persistence, frame pacing and thermal policy, offscreen export)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-A03-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are all five brainstorm capabilities and five version 0.1 needs enumerated as matrix rows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-A03-002, §SC-A03-002]
- [x] CHK004 Are negative requirements listed, each with its forbidding source? [Completeness, Spec §FR-A03-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are the three matrix statuses and the evidence rule (file, public non-test symbol, product) defined unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A03-002, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is the treatment of shader float precision and deep-zoom coordinates (status, how precision is determined, the clamp, ownership) stated without assuming double precision? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK007 Are the stop conditions concrete, including a precision promise beyond what the shader path can verify? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A03-009]

## Architecture Ownership

- [x] CHK008 Does every gap entry require an owning VisualCore module or a justified app-local exception? [Consistency, Spec §FR-A03-008, Constitution II]
- [x] CHK009 Is it explicit that the fractal formulas stay app-domain with a CPU reference while generic viewport, precision, palette, bookmark and capture machinery goes to VisualCore? [Consistency, Spec §FR-A03-008, Constitution A03]
- [x] CHK010 Is the no-modification rule for VisualCore and ProjectM measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-A03-007, §SC-A03-006]
- [x] CHK011 Is ProjectM independence of the new target required and verifiable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-A03-006]

## Privacy, Lifecycle and Platform

- [x] CHK012 Are permissions and networking for the shell explicitly excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-A03-005, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK013 Is it explicit that Phase 00 creates no render host or GPU resources? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A03-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are unlimited-deep-zoom, scientific-precision and device-performance claims excluded? [Consistency, Spec §FR-A03-011, Constitution V]

## Testability and Acceptance

- [x] CHK015 Are all success criteria quantified with counts or percentages? [Measurability, Spec §SC-A03-001–007]
- [x] CHK016 Are both simulator runtimes required for the shell smoke test? [Coverage, Spec §SC-A03-003]
- [x] CHK017 Is the regression baseline defined by named steps, with failure treated as a blocker? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §Edge Cases]

## Performance and Release

- [x] CHK018 Is it explicit that no performance budget is set in Phase 00, and where budgets come from later? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK019 Are the bundle identity and target location fixed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-A03-005]
- [x] CHK020 Does traceability require every version 0.1 feature and journey to map to a phase? [Coverage, Spec §FR-A03-010, §SC-A03-007]
